facts.fact: The CNPA says the new Code de l'information et de la communication (Loi N°25-021/AU of 26 December 2025, promulgated by Décret N°26-023/PR of 2 February 2026) requires explicit labelling of any content generated or heavily modified by artificial intelligence, under its Article 231.
